title: Energy Vault to supply 1.25GW power platform for hyperscaler AI data centre
summary: Energy Vault has secured a deal to provide 1.25GW of power infrastructure for a Texas AI data center, promoting sustainability through renewable energy solutions.

# Energy Vault to supply 1.25GW power platform for hyperscaler AI data centre


Energy Vault | 14 August 2026


Energy Vault has entered into a commercial agreement to deliver 1.25GW of integrated power infrastructure for a hyperscaler artificial intelligence (AI) data centre project in Texas, US.
